description: This file provides PHP code for managing keywords in the TestLink project, including creating, editing, deleting, and linking keywords, as well as initializing the user interface and handling form input.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used to store arbitrary data.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Defines input parameter types for validation.

classes.name: tl
classes.description: Namespace/class containing constants such as OK.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment variables and request parameters for the page.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Sets up the UI environment for creating a new keyword.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares the interface for editing an existing keyword.

methods.name: do_create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new keyword in the database.

methods.name: do_update
methods.description: Updates an existing keyword in the database.

methods.name: do_delete
methods.description: Deletes a keyword from the database.

methods.name: cfl
methods.description: Prepares UI for creating or linking a keyword.

methods.name: do_cfl
methods.description: Creates and links a keyword to a test case or version.

methods.name: getKeywordErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns user-friendly messages based on keyword validation error codes.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object with user rights and context for keywords management.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view or modify keywords.
